answer:
The provided documents say LlamaIndex provides the `TokenCountingHandler` callback for counting tokens. The callbacks index lists it first among the supported callbacks:

"- [TokenCountingHandler](/python/examples/observability/tokencountinghandler) -> Flexible token counting for prompt, completion, and embedding token usage." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/observability/callbacks/index.md]

The cost analysis page also says token counting uses this handler: "Tokens are counted using the `TokenCountingHandler` callback." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/evaluating/cost_analysis/index.md]

The API reference page documents it as the member of the `llama_index.core.callbacks.token_counting` module: "- TokenCountingHandler" [llama_index/docs/api_reference/api_reference/callbacks/token_counter.md]
